package ai

// leon_core.go: Leon's text rules for the setup wizard's test message, the
// port of App/app/leon.py lines 31-290 and 433-510: redaction, folding, fixed
// replies, the prompt blocks, the user turn and the guardrail. Pure code; the
// data files (prompt, guest strings, facts catalog) are generated by
// App/scripts/leon_try_golden.py from the Python source.

import (
	_ "embed"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"unicode"

	"golang.org/x/text/cases"

	"github.com/jsfpechar-ops/jsfpecharoperations/go/internal/hostweb"
)

//go:embed leon_prompt.txt
var leonCharacter string

//go:embed leon_guest_i18n.json
var leonGuestJSON []byte

//go:embed leon_facts_catalog.json
var leonFactsJSON []byte

// leonGuest holds the guest strings (i18n.py) Leon's fixed replies read.
var leonGuest = hostweb.Load(leonGuestJSON)

// Limits (leon.py lines 31-36).
const (
	LeonMaxTokens       = 500
	LeonMaxMessageChars = 500
	LeonMaxReplyChars   = 800
	LeonMaxSummaryChars = 300
)

var leonEmergencyNumbers = []string{"112", "150", "155", "158"}

// leonSchemaJSON is leon.SCHEMA, in the Python key order, compact.
const leonSchemaJSON = `{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"required":["kind","reply","sources","host_summary","upset"],"properties":{"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["answer","ask_host","refuse","about_me","emergency","unclear"]},"reply":{"type":"string"},"sources":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"host_summary":{"type":["string","null"]},"upset":{"type":"boolean"}}}`

// LeonSchema is the schema sent with every call.
func LeonSchema() json.RawMessage { return json.RawMessage(leonSchemaJSON) }

// --- redaction and folding ------------------------------------------------------------

var (
	leonPhoneRE = regexp.MustCompile(`^\+?\d[\d\s().-]{6,}\d\b`)
	leonLongRE  = regexp.MustCompile(`^(?:[A-Za-z]*\d){4,}[A-Za-z0-9-]*`)
	leonURLRE   = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(?:https?://|www\.)\S+`)
)

func leonIsWord(c byte) bool {
	return (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '_'
}

func leonIsRun(c byte) bool {
	return (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '-'
}

// leonPhones is _PHONE.finditer: (?<!\w)\+?\d(?:[\d\s().-]{6,}\d)(?!\w).
func leonPhones(s string) [][2]int {
	folded, _ := havelFold(s)
	var out [][2]int
	for i := 0; i < len(folded); {
		if (i == 0 || !leonIsWord(folded[i-1])) {
			if m := leonPhoneRE.FindStringIndex(folded[i:]); m != nil {
				out = append(out, [2]int{i, i + m[1]})
				i += m[1]
				continue
			}
		}
		i++
	}
	return out
}

// leonLongIDs is _LONG_ID.finditer: a token of 6 or more letters, digits and
// hyphens with at least four digits, that does not touch another word character.
func leonLongIDs(s string) [][2]int {
	folded, _ := havelFold(s)
	var out [][2]int
	for i := 0; i < len(folded); {
		if (i == 0 || !(leonIsWord(folded[i-1]) || folded[i-1] == '-')) && leonIsRun(folded[i]) {
			j := i
			for j < len(folded) && leonIsRun(folded[j]) {
				j++
			}
			if j-i >= 6 && (j == len(folded) || folded[j] != '_') && leonLongRE.MatchString(folded[i:j]) {
				out = append(out, [2]int{i, j})
				i = j
				continue
			}
		}
		i++
	}
	return out
}

// LeonRedact is leon.redact: e-mails, phone numbers and id-like runs become placeholders.
func LeonRedact(text string) string {
	text = havelSub(havelEmailRE, text, func(string) string { return "[email]" })
	text = havelSubSpans(text, leonPhones(text), func(string) string { return "[phone]" })
	return havelSubSpans(text, leonLongIDs(text), func(string) string { return "[number]" })
}

// leonFold is leon.fold: casefolded, every run of non-word characters one space.
func leonFold(text string) string {
	folded := cases.Fold().String(text)
	var b strings.Builder
	space := true
	for _, r := range folded {
		if unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.IsNumber(r) || r == '_' {
			b.WriteRune(r)
			space = false
		} else if !space {
			b.WriteByte(' ')
			space = true
		}
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
}

var leonHello = leonSet("hi", "hello", "hey", "good morning", "good evening", "good afternoon", "good night",
	"ahoj", "dobry den", "dobrý den", "dobry vecer", "dobrý večer", "zdravim", "zdravím", "cau", "čau",
	"hallo", "guten tag", "guten abend", "guten morgen",
	"hola", "buenas", "buenos dias", "buenos días", "buenas tardes", "buenas noches",
	"bonjour", "bonsoir", "salut",
	"привіт", "добрий день", "добрий вечір", "вітаю")

var leonThanks = leonSet("thanks", "thank you", "thanks a lot", "thank you very much", "ok thanks", "great thanks", "perfect thanks",
	"diky", "díky", "dekuji", "děkuji", "dekuju", "děkuju", "super diky", "super díky", "diky moc", "díky moc",
	"danke", "vielen dank", "danke schon", "danke schön",
	"gracias", "muchas gracias",
	"merci", "merci beaucoup",
	"дякую", "дуже дякую")

func leonSet(items ...string) map[string]bool {
	m := map[string]bool{}
	for _, i := range items {
		m[i] = true
	}
	return m
}

// LeonSmalltalkKind is leon.smalltalk_kind: "hi", "thanks" or "".
func LeonSmalltalkKind(text string) string {
	f := leonFold(text)
	if leonHello[f] {
		return "hi"
	}
	if leonThanks[f] {
		return "thanks"
	}
	return ""
}

// LeonIsNoise is leon.is_noise: no letter at all (or nothing but a link).
func LeonIsNoise(text string) bool {
	for _, r := range havelSub(leonURLRE, text, func(string) string { return "" }) {
		if (unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Nl, r) || unicode.Is(unicode.No, r)) && !unicode.Is(unicode.Nd, r) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

var leonCompanyRE = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(s\.\s?r\.\s?o|a\.\s?s\.|spol\.|z\.\s?s\.|ltd|gmbh|inc\b|llc|\d)`)

// leonHostFirstName is leon.host_first_name.
func leonHostFirstName(name string) string {
	name = strings.Join(havelFields(name), " ")
	if name == "" || havelSearch(leonCompanyRE, name) {
		return name
	}
	return strings.SplitN(name, " ", 2)[0]
}

// leonFixed is leon._fixed: a guest string in the guest's language.
func leonFixed(lang, key string, params map[string]any) string { return leonGuest.T(lang, key, params) }

// leonNamed is leon._named: key with the host's first name, or key+"_plain".
func leonNamed(lang, key, hostName string) string {
	if first := leonHostFirstName(hostName); first != "" {
		return leonFixed(lang, key, map[string]any{"host": first})
	}
	return leonFixed(lang, key+"_plain", nil)
}

// --- the guide as the model sees it -----------------------------------------------------------

// LeonCard is one card of guide_facts.for_guest: the card's own text, its
// quick-answer lines and its photo count.
type LeonCard struct {
	ID                                 int64
	Kind, Title, Location, Steps       string
	WatchOut, VideoURL                 string
	Photos                             int64
	Facts                              []string
}

func leonClean(text string) string {
	return havelStrip(strings.Map(func(r rune) rune {
		if r == '<' || r == '>' {
			return ' '
		}
		return r
	}, text))
}

// LeonCardTitle is leon.card_title.
func LeonCardTitle(c LeonCard) string {
	if c.Kind == "custom" {
		return leonClean(c.Title)
	}
	return leonStrings.T("en", "guest_guide.kind."+c.Kind+".title", nil)
}

func leonSorted(cards []LeonCard) []LeonCard {
	out := append([]LeonCard(nil), cards...)
	sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].ID < out[j].ID })
	return out
}

// LeonGuideBlock is leon.guide_block: the guide as one deterministic text
// block, sorted by id, host text with < and > removed.
func LeonGuideBlock(cards []LeonCard, propertyName string) string {
	lines := []string{`<guide property="` + leonClean(propertyName) + `">`}
	for _, c := range leonSorted(cards) {
		lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("[c%d] %s", c.ID, LeonCardTitle(c)))
		var facts []string
		for _, f := range c.Facts {
			facts = append(facts, leonClean(f))
		}
		if len(facts) > 0 {
			lines = append(lines, "facts: "+strings.Join(facts, " "))
		}
		if c.Location != "" {
			lines = append(lines, "where: "+leonClean(c.Location))
		}
		var steps []string
		for _, s := range havelSplitLines(c.Steps) {
			if s = havelStrip(s); s != "" {
				steps = append(steps, leonClean(s))
			}
		}
		if len(steps) > 0 {
			lines = append(lines, "steps:")
			lines = append(lines, steps...)
		}
		if c.WatchOut != "" {
			lines = append(lines, "watch out: "+leonClean(c.WatchOut))
		}
		var media []string
		if c.Photos > 0 {
			media = append(media, "photo")
		}
		if c.VideoURL != "" {
			media = append(media, "video")
		}
		if len(media) > 0 {
			lines = append(lines, "media: "+strings.Join(media, ", "))
		}
		lines = append(lines, "")
	}
	lines = append(lines, "</guide>")
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
}

// LeonSystemBlocks is leon.system_blocks: the character and the guide.
func LeonSystemBlocks(cards []LeonCard, propertyName string) []string {
	return []string{leonCharacter, LeonGuideBlock(cards, propertyName)}
}

// LeonUserTurn is leon.user_turn: the only per-request text the model gets.
func LeonUserTurn(redacted, lang string) string {
	return "Page language: " + lang + ".\n<guest_message>\n" + leonClean(redacted) + "\n</guest_message>"
}

// LeonEmergencyText is leon.emergency_text: fixed copy with 112, then the
// host's emergency card as the host wrote it.
func LeonEmergencyText(lang string, cards []LeonCard) string {
	lines := []string{leonFixed(lang, "leon_emergency", nil)}
	for _, c := range cards {
		if c.Kind == "emergency" {
			if c.Location != "" {
				lines = append(lines, leonClean(c.Location))
			}
			for _, s := range havelSplitLines(c.Steps) {
				if havelStrip(s) != "" {
					lines = append(lines, leonClean(s))
				}
			}
			break
		}
	}
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
}

// --- the guardrail -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

// LeonVerdict is the server's verdict on one model reply.
type LeonVerdict struct {
	Kind    string
	Text    string
	Sources []int64
	Summary string
	Upset   bool
	Reason  string
}

var (
	leonForbiddenRE = regexp.MustCompile("(?i)https?:|www\\.|@|<|>|\\*\\*|`")
	leonStepNumRE   = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^\s*\d{1,2}[.)]`)
	leonCardIDRE    = regexp.MustCompile(`^c([0-9]+)$`)
)

func leonStr(v any) string {
	if !havelTruthy(v) {
		return ""
	}
	return havelPyStr(v)
}

func leonCorpus(cards []LeonCard, ids []int64) string {
	want := map[int64]bool{}
	for _, id := range ids {
		want[id] = true
	}
	var parts []string
	for _, c := range cards {
		if want[c.ID] {
			parts = append(parts, strings.Join([]string{LeonCardTitle(c), strings.Join(c.Facts, " "), c.Location, c.Steps, c.WatchOut}, " "))
		}
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
}

// LeonValidate is leon.validate: a reply survives as an answer only with a
// cited card that exists, every number from a cited card, the guest's message
// or the emergency numbers, no address or markup, and a sane length.
func LeonValidate(data map[string]any, cards []LeonCard, guestText string) LeonVerdict {
	kind, _ := data["kind"].(string)
	summary := havelClip(havelStrip(LeonRedact(leonStr(data["host_summary"]))), LeonMaxSummaryChars)
	upset := havelTruthy(data["upset"])
	switch kind {
	case "refuse", "about_me", "unclear":
		return LeonVerdict{Kind: kind, Reason: "model"}
	case "emergency":
		return LeonVerdict{Kind: kind, Summary: summary, Upset: true, Reason: "model"}
	case "answer":
	default:
		return LeonVerdict{Kind: "ask_host", Summary: summary, Upset: upset, Reason: "model"}
	}
	known := map[int64]bool{}
	for _, c := range cards {
		known[c.ID] = true
	}
	var ids []int64
	for _, raw := range havelList(data["sources"]) {
		if m := leonCardIDRE.FindStringSubmatch(havelStrip(havelPyStr(raw))); m != nil {
			n, _ := strconv.ParseInt(m[1], 10, 64)
			dup := false
			for _, id := range ids {
				dup = dup || id == n
			}
			if known[n] && !dup {
				ids = append(ids, n)
			}
		}
	}
	text := havelStrip(leonStr(data["reply"]))
	fail := func(reason string) LeonVerdict {
		return LeonVerdict{Kind: "ask_host", Summary: summary, Upset: upset, Reason: reason}
	}
	if len(ids) == 0 {
		return fail("no_source")
	}
	if text == "" || havelLen(text) > LeonMaxReplyChars {
		return fail("length")
	}
	if havelSearch(leonForbiddenRE, text) {
		return fail("markup")
	}
	allowed := strings.Join(append(append(havelFindAll(havelDigitsRE, leonCorpus(cards, ids)), havelFindAll(havelDigitsRE, guestText)...), leonEmergencyNumbers...), " ")
	allowedSet := map[string]bool{}
	for _, n := range strings.Fields(allowed) {
		allowedSet[n] = true
	}
	body := havelSub(leonStepNumRE, text, func(string) string { return "" })
	for _, run := range havelFindAll(havelDigitsRE, body) {
		if !allowedSet[run] {
			return fail("number")
		}
	}
	return LeonVerdict{Kind: "answer", Text: text, Sources: ids, Summary: summary, Reason: ""}
}

var leonFactsOnce sync.Once
var leonFacts [][4]string // fact, step, type, card kind

func leonFactCatalog() [][4]string {
	leonFactsOnce.Do(func() {
		var c struct {
			Facts [][4]string `json:"facts"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(leonFactsJSON, &c); err != nil {
			panic("leon: bad leon_facts_catalog.json: " + err.Error())
		}
		leonFacts = c.Facts
	})
	return leonFacts
}

// LeonFactLines is guide_facts.lines(apartment_id, "en"): card kind -> the
// guest lines of its answered quick-answer facts, in FACTS order.
func LeonFactLines(answers map[string]string) map[string][]string {
	out := map[string][]string{}
	for _, f := range leonFactCatalog() {
		fact, typ, card := f[0], f[2], f[3]
		value := answers[fact]
		if value == "" {
			continue
		}
		var text string
		switch typ {
		case "yesno":
			text = leonFixed("en", "guide_fact_"+fact+"_"+value, nil)
		case "time":
			text = leonFixed("en", "guide_fact_"+fact, map[string]any{"time": value})
		default:
			start, end, _ := strings.Cut(value, "-")
			text = leonFixed("en", "guide_fact_"+fact, map[string]any{"start": start, "end": end})
		}
		out[card] = append(out[card], text)
	}
	return out
}
